@@ -15,6 +15,28 @@ else:  # pragma: no cover
     from asyncio import iscoroutinefunction
 
 
+def is_callable_type(obj: Any, check_fn: Callable[[Any], bool]) -> bool:
+    if obj is None:
+        return False
+    if check_fn(obj):
+        return True
+    if isinstance(obj, partial):
+        return is_callable_type(obj.func, check_fn)
+    if hasattr(obj, "__wrapped__"):
+        return is_callable_type(obj.__wrapped__, check_fn)
+    if not inspect.isroutine(obj) and not inspect.isclass(obj):
+        dunder_call = getattr(obj, "__call__", None)
+        if dunder_call:
+            return is_callable_type(dunder_call, check_fn)
+    return False
+
+
+def is_async_callable(obj: Any) -> bool:
+    return is_callable_type(obj, iscoroutinefunction) or is_callable_type(
+        obj, inspect.isasyncgenfunction
+    )
+
